mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pending_tours (catalogueId, title, destination, description, price, primaryImageUrl, submittedBy, operationType, originalTourId, status) VALUES (#{catalogueId}, #{title}, #{destination}, #{description}, #{price}, #{primaryImageUrl}, #{submittedBy}, #{operationType}, #{originalTourId}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT pt.pendingTourId, pt.catalogueId, pt.title, pt.destination, pt.description, pt.price, pt.primaryImageUrl, pt.submittedBy, pt.operationType, pt.originalTourId, pt.status, pt.reviewedBy, pt.submissionTime, pt.reviewTime, u1.nickName as submitterName, u2.nickName as reviewerName FROM pending_tours pt LEFT JOIN users u1 ON pt.submittedBy = u1.userId LEFT JOIN users u2 ON pt.reviewedBy = u2.userId WHERE pt.pendingTourId = #{pendingTourId}

SELECT pt.pendingTourId, pt.catalogueId, pt.title, pt.destination, pt.description, pt.price, pt.primaryImageUrl, pt.submittedBy, pt.operationType, pt.originalTourId, pt.status, pt.reviewedBy, pt.submissionTime, pt.reviewTime, u1.nickName as submitterName, u2.nickName as reviewerName FROM pending_tours pt LEFT JOIN users u1 ON pt.submittedBy = u1.userId LEFT JOIN users u2 ON pt.reviewedBy = u2.userId WHERE pt.status = 0 ORDER BY pt.submissionTime ASC

SELECT pt.pendingTourId, pt.catalogueId, pt.title, pt.destination, pt.description, pt.price, pt.primaryImageUrl, pt.submittedBy, pt.operationType, pt.originalTourId, pt.status, pt.reviewedBy, pt.submissionTime, pt.reviewTime, u1.nickName as submitterName, u2.nickName as reviewerName FROM pending_tours pt LEFT JOIN users u1 ON pt.submittedBy = u1.userId LEFT JOIN users u2 ON pt.reviewedBy = u2.userId WHERE pt.status = #{status} ORDER BY pt.submissionTime ASC

SELECT pt.pendingTourId, pt.catalogueId, pt.title, pt.destination, pt.description, pt.price, pt.primaryImageUrl, pt.submittedBy, pt.operationType, pt.originalTourId, pt.status, pt.reviewedBy, pt.submissionTime, pt.reviewTime, u1.nickName as submitterName, u2.nickName as reviewerName FROM pending_tours pt LEFT JOIN users u1 ON pt.submittedBy = u1.userId LEFT JOIN users u2 ON pt.reviewedBy = u2.userId WHERE pt.submittedBy = #{submittedBy} ORDER BY pt.submissionTime DESC

SELECT pt.pendingTourId, pt.catalogueId, pt.title, pt.destination, pt.description, pt.price, pt.primaryImageUrl, pt.submittedBy, pt.operationType, pt.originalTourId, pt.status, pt.reviewedBy, pt.submissionTime, pt.reviewTime, u1.nickName as submitterName, u2.nickName as reviewerName FROM pending_tours pt LEFT JOIN users u1 ON pt.submittedBy = u1.userId LEFT JOIN users u2 ON pt.reviewedBy = u2.userId WHERE pt.originalTourId = #{originalTourId} ORDER BY pt.submissionTime DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE pending_tours SET status = #{status}, reviewedBy = #{reviewedBy}, reviewTime = NOW() WHERE pendingTourId = #{pendingTourId}
